name: Windows Command Shell
summary: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution. The Windows command shell (cmd) is the primary command prompt on Windows systems which is used in industrial control system environments. The Windows command prompt can be used to control almost any aspect of a system, with various permission levels required for different subsets of commands. analytics.name: Analytic 2087
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies cmd.exe or .bat/.cmd execution from an unexpected parent or user context, execution from transient/user-writable paths, suspicious command chaining, or shell activity followed by OT-relevant discovery, credential, remote-access, or configuration behavior. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior.
